name: 76502 · Temple, TX
findings: ZIP 76502 (Temple) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76502 (Temple) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
